definitions.gloss: vinegared dish, food dressed with vinegar
definitions.explanation: A category of Japanese dishes made with vinegar-based dressing, often served cold as a refreshing side dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胡瓜|きゅうり}→胡瓜：05195_kyuuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢|す}の{物|もの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a cucumber vinegared dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{酢|す}の{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦さっぱり→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: In summer, vinegared dishes taste refreshingly light.

examples.japanese: {酢|す}の{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食欲|しょくよく}→食欲：03249_shokuyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{食|た}べやすい→食べやすい：21799_tabeyasui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Vinegared dishes are easy to eat even when you don't have much appetite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蛸|たこ}→蛸：04323_tako⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胡瓜|きゅうり}→胡瓜：05195_kyuuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢|す}の{物|もの}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦おつまみ→おつまみ：14928_otsumami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ぴったり→ぴったり：02362_pittari⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: Octopus and cucumber vinegared dish is perfect as a drinking snack.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{献立|こんだて}→献立：04155_kondate⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦さっぱりさせる→さっぱり：02777_sappari⟧⟦ために→ために：28332_tameni⟧{酢|す}の{物|もの}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一品|いっぴん}→一品：08919_ippin⟧⟦{加|くわ}わる→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: A vinegared dish is often included in a Japanese meal to cleanse the palate.

notes:
One of the standard courses of a Japanese meal, alongside ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered dishes), ⟦{焼|や}き{物|もの}→焼き物：04974_yakimono⟧ (grilled) and ⟦{和|あ}え{物|もの}→和え物：04979_aemono⟧ (dressed). Served cold, in small portions, to refresh the palate.

TYPES:
The dressing gives the dish its flavor:
- {三杯酢|さんばいず}: vinegar, soy sauce and mirin
- {二杯酢|にはいず}: vinegar and soy sauce
- ⟦{甘酢|あまず}→甘酢：14851_amazu⟧: sweetened vinegar
- {土佐酢|とさず}: vinegar with bonito dashi

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{胡瓜|きゅうり}→胡瓜：05195_kyuuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢|す}の{物|もの}: cucumber sunomono
- ⟦{蛸|たこ}→蛸：04323_tako⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胡瓜|きゅうり}→胡瓜：05195_kyuuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢|す}の{物|もの}: octopus and cucumber
- {若布|わかめ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酢|す}の{物|もの}: wakame seaweed
- もずく{酢|ず}: mozuku seaweed in vinegar
